by.claim: RFC 003 proposes a Senior Cybersecurity Advisor whose hours go to cross-program coordination, advice, hiring support, and training — explicitly 'not work assigned to a single engagement' — and sits in the Front Office rather than on a delivery team. finance-and-billing.md describes TTS's entire revenue mechanism as cost recovery through billable engagement hours, with overhead from TTS/GSA 'allocated and not under our control.' A role structurally unable to bill an engagement has no seat in the only funding model TTS actually runs on. RFC 003 itself concedes the funding source is undetermined at approval time; locking in the position before that's resolved means undoing it later — cutting the role or forcing it into a billable structure it wasn't designed for — depends on whoever controls TTS/GSA overhead allocation, a lever finance-and-billing.md says TTS doesn't hold.
